title: Length-machine action
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with $k$ work tapes. For input-head movement $m$, work-head movement $d$, optional Boolean output $b$, and optional successor state $q$ of the enlarged machine, define an action with $k+1$ work tapes: it moves the input head by $m$, writes nothing on every work tape, leaves the first $k$ work heads stationary, moves the last work head by $d$, emits $b$ when present, and passes to $q$, halting when $q$ is absent.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
Successor state is optional state of $M$'s state type enlarged by $\mathrm{Fin}(4)\oplus\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$
